candidates.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
candidates.reason: 実CXL-hybrid memory prototypeでDRAM+SSDを統合しprefix prefetch/write bufferingによりmulti-turn KV reuseを評価する重点テーマ直結研究。

candidates.title: SwiftCache: Efficient LLM Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with Heterogeneous KV Cache Sharing
candidates.reason: co-located model間の余剰HBMとNVLinkを利用した異種KV共有でP99 TTFTと最大context長を改善。

candidates.title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
candidates.reason: non-uniform KV compressionを実用化するpage管理、静的budget、AOT load balancingをserving systemとして実装評価。

candidates.title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
candidates.reason: storage-to-decode追加経路とRDMA、global schedulerでagentic KV storage NIC bottleneckを解消しproduction workload評価。

candidates.title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
candidates.reason: agent phase別query bufferでKV evictionを行いpersistent multi-turn servingへ実装、SGLang比較でthroughput評価する最新研究。
